notes: PLAN.md §7: every dependency except Mac.apk, Go and MyGo is locked here. Those three follow their latest versions; their entries record what the last build used. 'status' is locked (in use and verified on the build machine), chosen (decided, not installed yet) or deferred (chosen in a later phase). doc/en-us/development.md explains how each is installed.

angle.compiler: ANGLE DEPS llvmorg-24-init-17044-gc3223914-43; build tool only, distinct from the runtime host compiler
angle.license: BSD-3-Clause (plus the licenses of its DEPS)
angle.use: P5a source build of ARM64 Windows libEGL.dll/libGLESv2.dll with Vulkan and D3D11; host experiment only, not packaged

hostVerification.vulkan: Dozen (Vulkan to D3D12), Mesa 26.3.0-devel git-e3fc7749c6, API 1.2.359; vendor ICD BLOCKED

jdk.name: Microsoft Build of OpenJDK 21
jdk.use: javac/jar for Mac.apk's Java side; jni.h for the host; the JVM winapk embeds in development. The JVM shipped to users is the private runtime of PLAN.md §2.4 (P7).

msvc.use: the linker, CRT and libraries clang-cl builds against

vcpkg.source: Visual Studio's built-in vcpkg, manifest mode

vulkan-headers.use: build time only; nothing of it ships

zlib.use: inflating APK entries in winapk (apk.cpp); ships as a DLL beside winapk.exe

liblzma.use: NativeOs.xzDecompress for .xz resource blobs in winapk-bridge.dll; ships as liblzma.dll beside winapk.exe

sqlite3.use: android.database.sqlite through upstream's NativeSqlite (native_sqlite.cpp in winapk-bridge.dll); ships as a DLL beside winapk.exe

capstone.use: the guest ELF loader's screen of ARM64 code (elf_loader.cpp in native-probe.exe); ships as a DLL beside native-probe.exe

vulkanLoader.use: Windows' own vulkan-1.dll from System32, loaded at run time; never shipped or replaced (AGENTS.md: leave the system alone)

skia.name: JetBrains Skiko (Skia Ganesh Direct3D 12)
skia.license: Apache-2.0 (Skiko) AND BSD-3-Clause (Google Skia) AND ICU
skia.use: P8 AGSL RuntimeShader and RenderEffect GPU execution over hardware Direct3D 12 (NativeSkiaD3D12 + skiko-windows-arm64.dll, T15)

androidNdk.use: building the guest ELF fixtures of P2 (T05, T06: tests/windows-arm64/guest-elf/fixtures.psd1, clang 21 for API 30) and the JNI fixtures of P4; the NDK's own tools are x64 and run emulated at build time only

androidSdk.use: aapt2 for framework-res (upstream's pinned build-tools), d8/aapt2/apksigner and android.jar for the fixture APKs of P1 (T03)

kotlinc.source: the Kotlin compiler bundled with Android Studio (plugins/Kotlin/kotlinc), or KOTLIN_HOME
kotlinc.use: compiling the Kotlin fixture T04 (G1.6); its kotlin-stdlib.jar is dexed into that APK, which is never shipped

frameworkRes.source: AOSP tag android-16.0.0_r2, API 36 (as upstream's scripts/build_framework_res.sh)
frameworkRes.built: build.ps1 -Component FrameworkRes with build-tools 36.0.0 aapt2: 66.4 MB, sha256 62eb212e59c34ce50ee862aa2e93fff9a1a8969ca566882149d8350e03e86d90 (2026-11-03); its public IDs equal android-36's android.jar
frameworkRes.use: the platform resource table staged with the runtime (P1)
